summary.text: Chad Clifford is a Democratic member of the Colorado House of Representatives from District 37 who was appointed on January 3, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described more than 25 years in emergency management with the American Red Cross and service as a police officer with the Colorado Rangers.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Clifford said he spent more than 25 years in emergency management as a Government Operations Lead for the American Red Cross, serves as a police officer with the Colorado Rangers and owns and operates businesses, including ADT Custom Protection.
Ballotpedia lists him as having served as a registered lobbyist for the Colorado Rangers reserve police force and for the American Red Cross.
A Democratic committee in Arapahoe County appointed Clifford to House District 37 on January 3, 2024, to replace Ruby Dickson.
He won a full term on November 5, 2024, defeating Kevin Biehl, and was unopposed in the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary; he faces Republican Jill Thompson in the general election.
For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee and was vice chair of the State, Civic, Military, and Veterans Affairs Committee.

In the survey, Clifford listed his priorities as housing affordability and inventory in Arapahoe County, balanced public safety, education funding, disability opportunity, veterans and first responders, and workers' rights.
He said he also chairs the Legislative Oversight for Jail Standards Committee.
